name: Fang of Githyiss
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details: A fresh specimen from a beast of this size is quite a find. Perhaps someone in Aldrassil familiar with the study of spiders would be interested in the fang.
narrative.objectives: Deliver the the Fang of Githyiss to someone interested in the study of spiders in Aldrassil.
narrative.offerRewardText: My, my. How I do love surprises, Platten.This specimen will surely help further my studies.
